paragraphs: Use positive customer service phrases like, “I can certainly check on that for you” or “Let me find out” to show the customer you’re eager to help.
To fully understand an issue, inquiry, or complaint, agents must practice active listening and allow customers to express their needs. To practice active listening when interacting with customers:
Repeat back what a customer says.
Acknowledge what customers have already done to troubleshoot.
Follow up with open-ended questions that encourage customers to elaborate.

Once you find a potential solution, communicate your plan of action. Be clear about what the solution is and how it’s going to solve the issue. Explain the reasoning behind your solution to establish a sense of expertise and trust with your customers. Your explanations should help set reasonable, attainable customer expectations.

A customer calls and says they can’t access your software’s newest features. You explain that you need to access their account by saying, “I’m going to access your account to see if you have the most updated version of our software. Working off an outdated version can cause the problem you’re having for [x, y, and z] reasons. From there, I’ll run a diagnostic check to ensure the issue isn’t on our end.”
translations: 可以用“我当然可以帮您查一下”或“我来确认一下”等积极表达，让客户知道你愿意提供帮助。
要真正弄清问题、咨询事项或投诉，客服人员需要认真倾听，并让客户说清自己的需求。练习积极倾听时，可以：
认可客户已经采取的排查措施。
继续用开放式问题追问，鼓励客户补充细节。
找到可能的解决办法后，要把处理计划说清楚：具体要做什么、它怎样解决问题，以及为什么这样做。解释过程有助于建立专业和信任，也能让客户对结果有合理预期。
客户来电说无法使用软件的最新功能。客服说明需要查看客户账户，以确认软件是否已更新到最新版本。使用过时版本可能会造成客户遇到的这类问题；接下来会运行一次诊断检查，确认问题是否由公司一方造成。

Follow these call center tips to improve customer satisfaction, reduce agent burnout, and boost productivity.

The Zendesk Customer Experience Trends Report reveals that despite the availability of digital support channels, many customers still prefer phone calls for resolving complex and nuanced issues. During customer service calls, teams must nail customer courtesy and call center etiquette to build rapport, trust, and loyalty.

By following phone customer service tips, teams can turn a problem into a positive experience by communicating with customers in a way that makes them feel supported and understood. Starting a successful call center relies on agents excelling in their roles and managers effectively overseeing operations and technology. To help with both, we compiled a list of 18 essential call center tips.
1. Keep the conversation positive
3. Personalize your interactions
4. Have professional empathy
5. Respect your customers’ time
7. Walk customers through your solution
8. Don’t be afraid to tag in help
11. Create an after-call summary for continued learning
12. Report consistent patterns and roadblocks to management
14. Leverage AI to boost productivity
17. Use forecasting to schedule agents
18. Choose the right call center software
Frequently asked questions
Drive better customer experiences with proper call center etiquette

Using negative language or a poor customer service voice highlights limitations and what can’t be done for customers. However, by staying positive and upbeat, agents can reassure callers and effectively deal with angry customers.
To keep the conversation positive:
Keep a calm tone of voice to build rapport and customer trust.
Use positive customer service phrases like, “I can certainly check on that for you” or “Let me find out” to show the customer you’re eager to help.
Remember that body language can also translate over the phone. Smiling while interacting with a customer can help you sound friendlier and maintain a positive mindset.
To fully understand an issue, inquiry, or complaint, agents must practice active listening and allow customers to express their needs. To practice active listening when interacting with customers:
Repeat back what a customer says.
Verify requests and confirm solutions.
Acknowledge what customers have already done to troubleshoot.
Follow up with open-ended questions that encourage customers to elaborate.
Customers want to feel heard. Whether dealing with difficult customers or answering a simple question, patience and active listening can build trust and help customers feel acknowledged.

One of the best practices for chat etiquette is to be personal, and this approach extends to all forms of customer interactions. Whether you use customer names to open conversations or tailor language to a customer’s journey, personalization is necessary for creating meaningful experiences.

Arm agents with robust customer profiles so they can access critical customer context to personalize calls. According to our CX Trends Report, 62 percent of agents say that having access to data to personalize interactions would help them do their job better.

All too often, customers will lash out at call center agents. Effectively supporting these customers on calls—without escalating their frustration—requires call center skills like patience and empathy. Before responding to a frustrated customer, take a deep breath to reorient and remind yourself of the end goal.

Keep your conversation focused on potential solutions while acknowledging your customer’s frustration. Don’t over-promise—remind yourself that an angry response isn’t personal. While a caller’s tone of voice may be aggressive, keep yours positive and professional.
Remember to put yourself in their shoes while responding to their issue. Considering the customer’s frustration, time, and expectations can help you better understand their wants and needs.

Customers are busy, and callers expect agents to resolve support issues quickly and conveniently. Aim to answer every incoming call within two to three rings and keep the average handle time to around six minutes.

Give customers the option to receive a call or text back so they don’t have to wait on hold. Our CX Trends Report revealed that 60 percent of callers frequently experience transfers between agents or departments. To address this, ensure agents have the essential context to resolve every issue swiftly and effectively.
While call center scripts are great tools for customer support, relying too heavily on them can make support agents sound robotic. Keep conversations natural and relatable by:
Adding a personal flair and using anecdotes
Pausing regularly to check in with your customer
Prioritizing two-way communication to avoid the customer feeling “talked at”
Use simple language and avoid complex phrases, jargon, and acronyms to help customers understand solutions.

Once you find a potential solution, communicate your plan of action. Be clear about what the solution is and how it’s going to solve the issue. Explain the reasoning behind your solution to establish a sense of expertise and trust with your customers. Your explanations should help set reasonable, attainable customer expectations.

A customer calls and says they can’t access your software’s newest features. You explain that you need to access their account by saying, “I’m going to access your account to see if you have the most updated version of our software. Working off an outdated version can cause the problem you’re having for [x, y, and z] reasons. From there, I’ll run a diagnostic check to ensure the issue isn’t on our end.”

After walking the customer through your solution and finding they simply need a software update, you ask if they have any questions. Your customer says they understand, and you update the system and solve the problem.

If you need to escalate a support ticket or are dealing with an incredibly frustrated customer, ask for help. Involve a manager to address the situation quickly and effectively while maintaining your customer relations. Even if you are the best agent to solve the problem, you don’t need to handle everything angry customers throw your way on your own.

Customers highly value transparency. Apologize or admit when your business makes a mistake. Be okay with being human, own up to the issue, and provide actionable solutions. A customer apology letter can also prevent churn and build customer loyalty, even in the face of a mistake, quality issue, or other error.

How you handle customer calls reflects the values of your business, so go above and beyond in your service interactions. Prepare for calls by reviewing past interactions and considering customer sentiment.

Follow up by sending a customer thank you note, reaching out to see if they have questions, or asking for feedback to improve future experiences. You can also send customers self-service resources about products or services to reduce their need for further interactions.
Your work isn’t over once you hang up a customer service call. You must follow post-call best practices, such as writing a call summary and noting any next steps.

AI tools can streamline this process by automatically generating an after-call summary with a list of next steps, eliminating the need for manual note-taking. Before finalizing each summary, fact-check and add any personal or customer feedback other agents should know.

These summaries can highlight key moments from each call, providing insights to help you resolve similar issues more efficiently in the future and improve call center customer satisfaction. Managers can also reference the summaries during one-on-one coaching sessions to enhance agent performance.

Team leads and agents must work together to deliver stellar customer service. If you notice recurring issues (internal or external), alert management to collaborate and identify solutions. Whether you’re dealing with a difficult customer, answering repeat questions about a service or product, or experiencing other patterns or roadblocks, leverage your management team for effective troubleshooting.

Employee well-being can impact business operations, so taking regular breaks and prioritizing self-care is critical to staying personally and professionally healthy. Consider using these breaks to stretch, practice yoga, take walks, drink water, or do something else you enjoy.
Simplify interactions and streamline solutions by leveraging call center software with AI features and automation. AI in customer service can:
Intelligently route calls to the best, most qualified agents based on customer sentiment, intent, and language
Prepare after-call summaries and a list of next steps
Generate call transcripts automatically
Deflect calls to AI agents over digital channels
By handling previously manual tasks, AI frees up call center representatives to focus on other activities, increasing productivity.

Quality monitoring (QM) is the process of reviewing all interactions to optimize performance and reduce customer churn. Using AI-powered quality assurance tools, teams can consistently analyze conversations, identify problematic interactions, and provide coaching or training for agents, which can foster agent engagement.
QM involves tracking call center metrics like first contact resolution, average talk time, and call abandonment rate to evaluate a call center’s success and efficiency.

While call listening is a best practice for identifying problem areas, it’s also helpful for recognizing employees who exceed expectations. Use your findings to highlight good work, skill growth, and employee achievements. Public (or private) employee recognition can improve the agent experience and encourage other agents to go above and beyond for customers.

Good customer service requires thoughtful staffing and accurate future planning. By analyzing historical data, workforce forecasting helps customer service call center managers predict staffing needs and reduce overtime or scheduling gaps. Meanwhile, AI workforce management tools can automatically schedule call center agents and personalize each team member’s shift, saving time for both managers and agents.

Forecasting is crucial for call center workforce management, as it helps streamline time tracking, optimize productivity, and mitigate risks associated with seasonality, business demand, and customer expectations.
Your call center is only as strong as the call center software that supports it. Invest in software that enhances the employee experience (EX) by choosing a solution that offers:
Omnichannel options to meet customers where they are
Integration capabilities with existing systems
Scalability to grow with a business
Security systems to enhance customer data privacy
Reporting and analytics to get a deeper look into performance
At Zendesk, we offer modern call center software options with advanced features, including AI agents, intelligent routing, and other AI capabilities that streamline customer interactions.

Whether you run an inbound or outbound call center, too many negative support experiences can lead to customer churn and harm your company’s reputation. By following our customer service tips for call centers and implementing proper etiquette and call center management best practices, you can prevent those issues and build a thriving call center.

To maintain the success of your call center, you must prioritize your agents’ well-being by encouraging breaks, mindfulness, and reasonable boundaries. This approach will enable them to provide innovative solutions without compromising their wellness.
Investing in a comprehensive, AI-powered customer service software solution like Zendesk will also empower you to develop better customer relationships and enhance the employee experience.

notes.phrase: I can certainly check on that for you
notes.meaning: 我当然可以帮您查一下
notes.explain: 先回应客户，再说明自己会做什么。
notes.example: I can certainly check on that for you. Let me review the account first.

notes.phrase: Repeat back what a customer says
notes.explain: 用自己的话确认问题，避免还没听明白就开始猜原因。
notes.example: Let me make sure I understand: you can’t access the new feature.

notes.meaning: 说明接下来的处理计划
notes.explain: 按顺序讲清检查步骤，让客户知道接下来会发生什么。
notes.example: I’ll check your software version, then run a diagnostic check.

scenario.title: 模拟客服沟通：客户打不开新功能
english: A customer cannot access the latest features and says they have already restarted the app.
You need to confirm what they have tried, check whether their software is up to date, and explain the next diagnostic step.
Keep the customer informed about what you are checking and why.
chinese: 客户打不开软件的最新功能，并说自己已经重启过应用。
你要先确认客户试过什么，再检查软件是否为最新版本，并说明下一步的诊断检查。
告诉客户你正在检查什么，以及这样做的原因。

firstAttempt.prompt: 客户打不开新功能，并说已经重启过应用。请先复述并确认问题，再说明你将检查软件版本、运行诊断，并解释下一步。
firstAttempt.sample: Let me make sure I understand: you can’t access the new feature, and you’ve already restarted the app. I’ll check whether your software is up to date, then run a diagnostic check to see if the issue is on our end. I’ll explain what I find before we try the next step.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先确认问题和客户已做的尝试，再按顺序说明检查计划。

taskPhrases.word: Let me make sure I understand…
taskPhrases.meaning: 让我确认一下我理解得对不对……
taskPhrases.example: Let me make sure I understand: you can’t access the new feature.
taskPhrases.translation: 让我确认一下我理解得对不对：你现在无法使用这个新功能。

taskPhrases.word: I can see you’ve already tried…
taskPhrases.example: I can see you’ve already tried restarting the app.
taskPhrases.translation: 我知道你已经试过重启应用了。

taskPhrases.example: I’ll check your software version, then run a diagnostic check.
taskPhrases.translation: 我会先检查软件版本，然后运行一次诊断检查。

words.example: We’re troubleshooting the login issue now.
words.translation: 我们正在排查登录问题。
words.note: 常用于技术支持中定位问题并尝试解决。

words.meaning: 最新的；更新到当前版本的
words.example: Could you check whether the app is up to date?
words.translation: 你能检查一下应用是否为最新版本吗？
words.note: 通常说 software is up to date；out of date 表示过时的。

words.example: I’ll run a diagnostic check to see where the error is coming from.
words.translation: 我会运行一次诊断检查，看看错误出在哪里。
words.note: run a check 表示进行一次检查。

structure.original: Once you find a potential solution, communicate your plan of action.
analysis: Once 引出“找到可能的解决办法之后”这一时间点。
communicate your plan of action 用来说明接下来会采取什么措施。
structure.transfer: Once I confirm the account settings, I’ll send you the steps to restore access.

rewrite.bad: It’s probably your old version. Just update it.
rewrite.good: Let me make sure I understand: you can’t access the new feature, and you’ve already restarted the app. I’ll check whether your software is up to date, then run a diagnostic check. I’ll explain what I find before we try the next step.
rewrite.translation: 让我确认一下我理解得对不对：你现在无法使用这个新功能，而且已经重启过应用。我会先检查软件是否为最新版本，然后运行一次诊断检查。我们进行下一步之前，我会先告诉你检查结果。
rewrite.pattern: Let me make sure I understand: [issue]. I’ll check [first step], then [next step].

cloze.prompt: Let me make sure I ______: you can’t access the new feature.
cloze.why: make sure I understand 用来确认自己正确理解了客户的问题。

cloze.prompt: I can see you’ve already tried ______ the app.
cloze.why: try doing something 表示尝试做某事。

cloze.prompt: I’ll check the software version, ______ run a diagnostic check.
cloze.why: then 按先后顺序连接两步处理计划。

dictation.text: I can certainly check on that for you.
dictation.why: 听出 can certainly check 这一积极回应，以及 on that 的连读。

dictation.text: I’ll run a diagnostic check to see if the issue is on our end.
dictation.why: 留意 run a 的连读和 to see if 引出的检查目的。

translationPractice.prompt: 让我确认一下我理解得对不对：你现在无法使用这个新功能。
translationPractice.answer: Let me make sure I understand: you can’t access the new feature.
translationPractice.why: 先复述客户的问题，确认双方理解一致。

translationPractice.prompt: 我知道你已经试过重启应用了。
translationPractice.answer: I can see you’ve already tried restarting the app.
translationPractice.why: 认可客户已经做过的排查，避免让对方重复操作。

translationPractice.prompt: 我会先检查软件版本，然后运行一次诊断检查。
translationPractice.answer: I’ll check your software version, then run a diagnostic check.
translationPractice.why: 用 I’ll check…, then… 按顺序交代处理步骤。

choice.prompt: 客户说新功能打不开，并表示已经重启过应用。哪种回应最清楚？
options: It’s probably your software. You should update it.
Let me make sure I understand: the new feature won’t open, and you’ve restarted the app. I’ll check your version, then run a diagnostic check.
Please wait while our technical team reviews the issue.
choice.why: 先确认问题和已做的尝试，再按顺序说清检查计划。

output.prompt: 客户无法导出月度报告，并说已经刷新过页面。请确认你听懂了什么，认可对方已做的尝试，说明你会检查账户权限并测试导出，最后说清何时回复。
output.sample: Let me make sure I understand: you can’t export the monthly report, and you’ve already refreshed the page. I’ll check your account permissions, then test the export from my side. I’ll update you with the result by 3 p.m.
check: 提到客户已经尝试过的操作
按顺序交代检查步骤，并说明回复时间

blockers: 人工听检音频与语速停顿
真实账号进度与生产页面验收
